newsitem.title: USA: Gundle/SLT sees lower Q2 gross margin.
newsitem.headline: Gundle/SLT sees lower Q2 gross margin.

text.p: Gundle/SLT Environmental Inc said Wednesday it expects second quarter gross profit margin to be down significantly from a year earlier due to current market conditions.

Higher prices for the company's primary raw material, polyethylene resin, and a market surplus of geosynthetic liner production capacity cut gross profit margin to 18.5 percent in the first quarter from 20.4 percent a year earlier, Gundle/SLT said in its first quarter earnings release.

"While it is our goal to match the selling price of our products with the cost of resin, excess liner production and the willingness of our competitors to bid projects at very low prices are preventing us from passing raw material price increases on to our customers," said Bill Reid, Gundle president and chief executive.
"The price competition extends worldwide as reduced landfill construction in the United States has caused domestic competitors to search for customers internationally."
Reid said he expects some price relief in polyethylene pricing late in the year as additional ethylene capacity comes on line.
